description: This file provides utility functions for exporting Excalidraw elements to various formats such as canvas, blob, SVG, and clipboard. It includes functions for exporting with options like dimensions, padding, and embedding metadata.

methods.name: exportToCanvas
methods.description: Exports Excalidraw elements to a canvas element with optional dimensions, padding, and exporting frame.

methods.name: exportToBlob
methods.description: Exports Excalidraw elements to a Blob object, supporting different MIME types and quality settings, with optional embedding of scene metadata.

methods.name: exportToSvg
methods.description: Exports Excalidraw elements to an SVG element, with options for padding, rendering embeddables, and font inlining.

methods.name: exportToClipboard
methods.description: Exports Excalidraw elements to the system clipboard in PNG, SVG, or JSON format.
